scope: New synthetic finite mechanism study, not a replay or confirmation of V6, not natural multimodal learning, not production owner integration
action_semantics: explicit uncertainty with partial task credit
repair_channel: One registered reliable retransmission; generated and read back anew; no hidden-target acquisition
primary_comparisons: risk_numeric versus mean_numeric on empirical CE
risk_numeric versus risk_zero on mean net return
interval_scope: Two prespecified paired synthetic-episode comparisons, each 97.5 percent percentile-bootstrap interval; not natural-source or training-seed population coverage
strong_control: risk_history receives identical complete public delivery readback and chooses repair from its registered consequences; no unique numeric advantage is presumed
shuffle_control: Permutes the scalar feedback across evaluation episodes; exact scalar marginal retained
reward_visibility: Only public delivery consistency feedback before continuation. Hidden target enters private score after final action and receipt have been persisted.
media: Deterministic semantic codecs: text, PNG, PCM tone WAV, uncompressed AVI. Audio is not speech; video is a finite moving marker, not learned natural video.
cost_units: Declared task-utility charges, including stochastic channel charge inside the outcome expectation. CPU and wall nanoseconds reported separately, no energy claim.
training_claim: Actual numpy gradient updates of a 4x3 categorical posterior and a two-parameter numeric-feedback policy. Media encoders/decoders are deterministic and untrained.
stopping_rule: One registered run, all rows/faults and negative comparisons retained; no parameter search using evaluation targets
